# Deenify

Your daily Islamic lifestyle app — Quran, Hadith, Adhan, Qibla, and more.

Website: https://deenify.pro
Support: support@deenify.pro

## Overview

Deenify is an Islamic lifestyle platform that provides tools and educational resources for Muslims worldwide.

## Features

- Quran
- Hadith
- Prayer Times
- Adhan
- Qibla
- Islamic Guides

## Canonical URL

https://deenify.pro
